title: Annual filing (Form PC) with the Attorney General
source: M.G.L. c. 12, § 8F; 940 CMR 2.00 — annual Form PC filing with the Non-Profit Organizations/Public Charities Division of the Attorney General's Office.
scope_note: A 12-month reminder. The real due date follows your fiscal year end, and a green row does not say the Form PC was accepted or that the rule applies to you.
